messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: p99 decode latency spike detected for hosted-generation us-west-2 at 06:12 UTC — routing anomalies + streaming stalls. Pager severity: P2.
jamie: saw the pager, jumping in. p99 jumped from 280ms -> 2.8s, p95 ~ 450ms. Lots of streaming stalls (clients reporting stalled chunks).
ravi: confirmed. Tracing shows heavy time spent in decode path kernels after rollout at 04:50 (build tag: runtime-2.7.1).
maria: is this the TRT/FlashAttention kernel rollout from last night? I saw an automated deploy to canary then to prod.
jamie: yes, that deploy included a new flash-attn kernel + gcc11 compile flags. Need to check compile path.
anita: customers impacted: two mid-market customers with high streaming usage showing errors/timeouts in their SLO dashboards. Notified CS.
ravi: stack: model v3.2.1 -> runtime 2.7.1 -> kernel flash-attn v1.4 -> nvdriver 535. Logs show repeated stalls in kv_cache fetch with long tail, stack trace snippet below:
```
decode() at runtime/kernel/flash_attn.cu:421
kernel_launch() -> cudaEventElapsedTime 2183ms
trt_invoke() at runtime/trt_runner.cc:187
```
jamie: interesting: the stalls correlate with certain sequence-lengths ~1024 and when continuous batching picks up. Could be kernel blocking on warps with compiler-opt differences.
maria: quick test: rollback kernel to flash-attn v1.3 on a single canary node? If that reduces p99 we can rollback cluster-wide.
ravi: already started a canary rollback on pool "gen-usw2-02". Monitoring now.
oncall-bot: Update: rollback job gen-usw2-02 -> flash-attn v1.3 started (job 8822). ETA 3m.
anita: any plan B if rollback doesn't fix? We should also consider reverting gcc11 flags to previous -O3 -march=.. configuration.
jamie: yes, plan B is compile-flag revert + pinning TRT plugin to earlier build. Also prepare routing rule to divert streaming traffic to us-east-1.
maria: routing rule drafted: route(streaming) -> fallback-region us-east-1 for customers with >200 concurrent streams. Need approval to flip.
jamie: approve flip. Do it only for affected customers to limit blast radius.
oncall-bot: gen-usw2-02 rollback finished. Health checks: readiness flapping but p95 trending down to 360ms. p99 still at ~900ms.
ravi: partial improvement — suggests kernel variant contributed but not full story. Pulling compile logs. Found a recent default flag: "-fno-unsafe-math-optimizations" removed in last build, changed FP rounding. Could be causing path divergence.
maria: that flag change lines up with the earlier canary acceptance window. Rebuilding a small kernel with the old flag now and running microbenchmarks on seqlen 1024.
jamie: also enable aggressive KV-cache bypass for streaming on gen pools as temporary mitigation: add header `x-rw-bypass-kv: true` for affected customers. This will increase tokens but reduce decode stalls.
anita: CS: notified premium customers A & B; they acknowledged and requested ETA. We gave 2hr initial ETA.
ravi: microbenchmarks show the rebuilt kernel with old flag drops 99th from 1.9s -> 240ms in isolated runs. Good signal.
maria: starting staged rollout of kernel build (reintroduce -funsafe-math? revert -fno-unsafe...) to canary nodes.
oncall-bot: run 8934: kernel-rebuild-canary started.
jamie: prepping handoff notes for next on-call in 50m: summary + mitigation steps + links.
anita: customer impact update: two customers still seeing occasional stalls but no 5xxs; streams resume after ~2s. We're offering credits proactively.
ravi: long term: add targeted perf test for seqlen distribution ~512-2048 with both compile flag sets on CI. Also add preflight that rejects kernel builds that regress p99 by >20%.
maria: agree — adding regression gate in the kernel CI and capture kernel perf profiles per hardware SKU.
jamie: ok handoff: primary mitigation = rollback flash-attn v1.3 -> partial relief. hotfix = rebuild kernels with previous FP flags + staged rollout. temporary traffic diversion to us-east for affected customers and KV-cache bypass header. Customer comms: CS owns copy.
oncall-bot: Handoff created: #oncall-handoff-1912345678, assigned to ravi for next shift.
anita: tagging infra:docker to keep an eye on image pin versions. Also will open a postmortem template.
ravi: leaving additional notes in runbook: how to pin kernel, revert compile flags, commands: 
```
rwctl kernel list --pool gen-usw2-02
rwctl kernel pin --pool gen-usw2-02 --kernel flash-attn@v1.3
rwctl deploy revert --tag runtime-2.7.0
```
jamie: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft. If anything spikes again ping me. :thumbsup:
